instruction: Can you disable the update notifications? I don't want to be bothered with update prompts.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling update notifications. Created custom check_qt_updates_notif__b84bb567 metric to validate the qt-updates-notif setting (0=disabled, 1=enabled) in vlcrc config file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable update notifications
Getter (get_vlc_config) extracts the right state: reads VLC's vlcrc configuration file from appropriate OS-specific location
Metric (check_qt_updates_notif__b84bb567) implements correct logic: searches for qt-updates-notif setting and compares against expected value '0' (disabled)
Expected value '0' is semantically correct for disabling update notifications (0=disabled, 1=enabled)
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are loaded
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact setting required by the instruction
